title: Integrating Supports to Promote PrEP for Black Adolescents Working With Apps- Alabama
official: Adolescent SPEAKS Study: Integrating Supports to Promote PrEP for Black Adolescents Working With Apps
summary: This study applies Social Cognitive Theory to develop behavioral interventions promoting PrEP adherence. It seeks to adapt and test the enhanced HMP app for feasibility and acceptability among Black adolescents and young adults (AYAs) and adult supports.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* African Americans
* Living in the state of Alabama
* Have a PrEP indication (e.g. sex with a partner living with HIV, condomless sex, sex with multiple partners, engagement in transactional sex, or at least one sexually transmitted infection in the past 6 months)
* Support Person:

  * \>21 years old
  * self-reported provision of instrumental, informational, or emotional support for a Black AYA 14-21 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV positive
* Inability to provide informed consent
